name: Cannalicious | 2g Live Resin | Garlic Mints
description: Garlic Mints is a pungent and euphoric indica-dominant hybrid cross between Garlic Cookies and Animal Mints, known for its savory garlic aroma and for delivering a calming and relaxing body high. Garlic Mints may help in managing chronic stress, anxiety, headaches, migraines, and muscle spasms.
